# FDG5048

> DO minimal work in the constructor.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.3 Constructor Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: how much work is minimal is a matter of judgment.

## From the book

Constructors should not do much work other than capture the constructor parameters. The cost of any other processing should be delayed until required.
